body.objective: Separate the coherent compact detector's operational no-click event from genuine BT forward survival, prove the exact leading survival-plus-leakage factorization, and decide whether the detector-local transition block determines the order-lambda8 BT virtual coefficient.
activates: an honest dynamical meaning for compact no-click
an exact nonidentifiability theorem for the local virtual coefficient
body.current_gate: Write the leading BT transition column as (A_C,B_out), derive pseudo-unitarity and all three click/leakage/survival coefficients, prove that no-click is independent of B_out while the forward virtual coefficient is not, and test the result on exact rational completions sharing the same detector click block.
body.stop_condition: Land an exact certificate and independent verifier for survival-plus-leakage factorization, two-completion nonidentifiability, the minimal-Julia boundary, compact-acceptance nonexhaustivity, and all Eq. 19/gravity boundaries.
body.forbid: no local no-click Kraus called BT survival; no compact detector block called a complete transition column; no unobserved leakage set to zero without an invariance certificate; no operational probability promoted to an all-time S matrix; no Eq. 19, loop, gravity, BRST or LORENTZIAN-CAUSAL promotion
body.resource_hint: For the C4^*C4 cut component of a complete positive order-lambda4 transition column C4=(A_C,B_out), pseudo-unitarity forces Herm(M8)_source,C4-cut=-(A_C^*A_C+B_out^*B_out)/2. The compact click probability is A_C^*A_C. True survival in this slice loses both terms, leakage restores B_out^*B_out inside the no-click event, and therefore E_no=I-A_C^*A_C without identifying no-click with survival. Other perturbative products and cut-free terms are separate. Two exact completions with the same A_C and different B_out prove that the local click data cannot determine the forward virtual coefficient. The minimal Julia dilation is the B_out=0 completion, not the unique BT completion.
